metadata.title: Sharon, Roman, Marder & Swinney (2002) Nature / Audoly & Boudaoud (2003) PRL / Liang & Mahadevan (2009) PNAS — Non-Euclidean Metric Edge Buckling Waves & Self-Similar Wrinkle Cascades in Ruffled Leaf Margins

lactuca_sativa_edge_waves_specimen.organism: Lactuca sativa cv. 'Lollo Bionda' (Ruffled garden lettuce exhibiting multi-generation self-similar edge buckling waves)

governing_equations.foppl_von_karman_energy: E[u, w] = int [ t * ||grad u + (1/2) grad w otimes grad w - eps_target(x)||^2 + (t^3 / 12(1 - nu^2)) * ||grad^2 w||^2 ] dx dy
governing_equations.target_riemannian_metric: ds^2 = dx^2 + g_yy(x) dy^2,  g_yy(x) = 1 + g_0 * exp(-x / ell),  eps_y(x) = (1/2)*(g_yy(x) - 1) = (1/2)*g_0*exp(-x / ell)
governing_equations.isometric_arc_length_conservation: 1 + (1/4) * sum_{m=1..M} (2*pi*A_m(x) / lambda_m)^2 = g_yy(x)  =>  A_m(x) / lambda_m = sqrt(w_m(x) * (g_yy(x) - 1)) / pi
governing_equations.subharmonic_cascade_scaling: lambda_{m} / lambda_{m+1} = r_cascade in [3, 5],  x_m = c_x * lambda_m,  lambda_loc(x) = c_lambda * x + lambda_min(t)
governing_equations.saddle_to_ripple_dimensionless_control: Gamma = g_0 * (ell / t)^2;  Gamma < Gamma_c => global saddle (M=1),  Gamma > Gamma_c => multi-generation edge ripple cascade (M >= 3)
